name: How long does garage paint last?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage paint last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of garage paint depends on the type of paint, surface preparation, and usage. For walls and ceilings, a good quality interior paint, properly applied, can last 5-10 years or more. Garage floor coatings, especially 2-part epoxy systems, are designed for high durability and can last 10-20 years with proper installation and maintenance. Factors like heavy vehicle traffic, chemical exposure, and temperature fluctuations can influence how long the paint retains its finish and protective qualities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage wall/ceiling paint lasts 5-10 years; 2-part epoxy floor coatings can last 10-20 years, depending on usage and preparation.
